title: Maine Revised Statutes Title 26, § 625-B - Severance pay due to closing, substantial shutdown or relocation
verified_how: Fetched title26ch7sec0.html: '26 §625-B: Severance pay due to closing, substantial shutdown or relocation' listed live under Subchapter 2, Wages and Medium of Payment, of Title 26, Chapter 7 (Employment Practices). Data extracted 10/20/2025; text current through October 1, 2025.
notes: One of the few genuine state severance-pay mandates in the US: one week's pay per year of service for employees of a covered establishment on a closing, substantial shutdown or relocation, alongside the notice duty in the same section. Individual dismissal remains at-will with no severance entitlement; federal WARN (29 U.S.C. 2101) also applies. Final-wage timing on separation is 26 M.R.S. § 626.
